tool_args.rationale: The field, gradient, and lag signatures favor the siphon-memory ODE. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that adds evidence to distinguish its transient parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons leave no redundancy and weakly distinguish the memory timescale from the coupling strength.
Neither model represents the observed transient lag or uses the initial state and memory.
It does not measure the trajectory needed to separate the coupled dynamics.
